title: The Health Impacts of Water Shutoffs in Detroit, Michigan

Using Machine Learning to Target Treatment: The Case of Household Energy Use
abstract: We use causal forests to evaluate the heterogeneous treatment effects (TEs) of repeated behavioral nudges towards household energy conservation. The average response is a monthly electricity reduction of 9 kilowatt-hours (kWh), but the full distribution of responses ranges from -30 to +10 kWh. Selective targeting of treatment using the forest raises social net benefits by 12-120 percent, depending on the year and welfare function. Pre-treatment consumption and home value are the strongest predictors of treatment effect. We find suggestive evidence of a "boomerang effect": households with lower consumption than similar neighbors are the ones with positive TE estimates.
abstract_zh: 我们运用因果森林方法，评估了针对家庭节能的重复性行为助推（nudges）所产生的异质性处理效应（TEs）。平均而言，助推使每月用电量减少9千瓦时（kWh），但全部响应的分布范围在-30至+10千瓦时之间。利用森林方法进行有选择的处理定向，可使社会净福利提高12%–120%，具体取决于年份和福利函数。处理前的消费量和住房价值是处理效应最强的预测因素。我们发现了“回旋镖效应”（boomerang effect）的初步证据：与相似邻居相比用电量较低的家庭，恰恰是处理效应估计值为正的家庭。

title: Environmental and Resource Economics and Systemic Racism
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This article highlights some ways in which scholarly work in environmental and natural resource economics may be affected by, and may unintentionally further, racial inequity. We discuss four channels through which these effects may occur. The first is prioritization of efficiency over distribution. The second is inattention to procedural justice. The third involves abstraction away from crucial historical or social contexts. The fourth is a narrow focus on problems that fit neatly within existing analytical and empirical frameworks. We follow these threads through three areas in which we offer examples of how environmental and natural resource economics work may further racial inequity. The first involves methods of evaluating and measuring human and social welfare. The second relates to policy modeling choices. The third centers on analysis of management of the commons. We document opportunities to improve the field by better considering how racial inequity may affect, and be affected by, environmental and natural resource economic analysis. Scholars in this field have tools that can mitigate systemic racism in access to natural resources and a clean environment, but work must be done before that potential is realized.
abstract_zh: 本文强调了环境与自然资源经济学的学术研究可能受到种族不平等影响，并可能无意中加剧种族不平等的一些方式。我们讨论了这些影响可能通过的四种渠道。第一是将效率置于分配之上。第二是对程序正义关注不足。第三是抽象化掉关键的历史或社会背景。第四是狭隘地聚焦于那些恰好符合既有分析与实证框架的问题。我们沿着这些线索，考察了三个领域，并举例说明环境与自然资源经济学研究可能如何加剧种族不平等。第一个领域涉及评估和衡量人类与社会福利的方法。第二个领域涉及政策建模的选择。第三个领域集中于公共资源管理的分析。我们记录了通过更好地考虑种族不平等如何影响环境与自然资源经济分析，以及如何受其影响，从而改进该领域的机会。该领域的学者拥有能够缓解自然资源获取和清洁环境方面系统性种族主义的工具，但要实现这一潜力，仍需开展大量工作。

title: The Promise and Peril of Carbon Neutrality Goals
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: The carbon neutrality goal has emerged as the most popular way for institutions to frame policy responses to climate change, largely because of its flexibility as a net-zero emissions target. We highlight two desirable features arising from this flexibility: the potential for reducing emissions at a lower cost and the potential for promoting distributive justice. To demonstrate the role of cost-effectiveness, we report estimates of average emissions abatement cost of solar electricity plants located (hypothetically) in each of the 48 states of the conterminous United States. We then explain how institutions may pursue distributive justice by targeting cobenefits of emissions-reducing projects to specific areas or groups. We also describe the two primary concerns with carbon neutrality goals: additionality and ethics. To allay these concerns, we suggest improvements to the basic integrity of carbon markets and ways in which institutions can commit to local decarbonization in tandem with carbon neutrality.
abstract_zh: 碳中和目标已成为各机构框架化气候变化政策应对的最流行方式，主要原因在于其作为净零排放目标所具有的灵活性。我们强调了这种灵活性所带来的两个理想特征：以较低成本减排的潜力，以及促进分配正义的潜力。为展示成本有效性的作用，我们报告了假设位于美国本土48个州的太阳能发电厂的平均减排成本估计值。随后，我们阐述了各机构如何通过将减排项目的协同效益定向至特定地区或群体，从而追求分配正义。我们还描述了碳中和目标面临的两大主要担忧：额外性和伦理。为缓解这些担忧，我们提出了改进碳市场基本诚信的建议，以及各机构在实现碳中和的同时，承诺推进本地脱碳的方式。

title: Vehicle Scrappage Policies for Transportation Decarbonization
abstract: Vehicle electrification is one of the primary strategies being pursued for the decarbonization of the transportation sector. But to meet emissions reduction goals for that sector, the current vehicle replacement rate is insufficient. Vehicle scrappage policies can accelerate fleet turnover by providing an incentive to retire a vehicle before its natural end of life and simultaneously replace it with a more efficient or less polluting alternative. Previous scrappage programs, like the United States’ Cash for Clunkers, have had limited success as decarbonization policies; however, most of these programs ended before the widespread availability of electric vehicles and did not have decarbonization as a primary policy goal. Here we explain why scrappage policies may be necessary to meet climate goals, review historic vehicle scrappage policies from a variety of countries, highlight the successes and failures of those policies, and establish policy design considerations that could help ensure that future scrappage programs are more successful than previous efforts.
abstract_zh: 车辆电动化是交通运输部门脱碳所追求的主要策略之一。但要实现该部门的减排目标，当前的车辆更新速度是不够的。车辆报废政策可以通过激励车主在车辆自然报废之前将其淘汰，并同时以效率更高或污染更少的车辆替代，从而加快车队更新。以美国的“旧车换新”（Cash for Clunkers）计划为代表的既往报废计划，作为脱碳政策的成效有限；然而，这些计划大多在电动汽车广泛普及之前就已结束，且并未将脱碳作为首要政策目标。在此，我们解释了为何报废政策对于实现气候目标可能是必要的，回顾了多个国家的历史车辆报废政策，指出了这些政策的成功与失败之处，并提出了政策设计的考量因素，以帮助确保未来的报废计划比以往的努力更为成功。

title: Widespread Range Suitability and Cost Competitiveness of Electric Vehicles for Ride-hailing Drivers
Inequality, Information Failures, and Air Pollution
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract:
Research spanning several disciplines has repeatedly documented disproportionate pollution exposure among the poor and communities of color. Among the various proposed causes of this pattern, those that have received the most attention are income inequality, discrimination, and firm costs (of inputs and regulatory compliance). We argue that an additional channel – information – is likely to play an important role in generating disparities in pollution exposure. We present multiple reasons for a tendency to underestimate pollution burdens, as well as empirical evidence that this underestimation can disproportionately affect low-income households. Using a model of housing choice, we then derive conditions under which “hidden” pollution leads to an inequality – even when all households face the same lack of information. This inequality arises because households sort according to known pollution and other disamenities, which we show are positively correlated with hidden pollution. To help bridge the gap between environmental justice and economics, we discuss the relationship between hidden information and three different distributional measures: exposure to pollution; exposure to hidden pollution; and welfare loss due to hidden pollution.
Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh:
多个学科的研究反复记录了穷人和有色人种社区承受着不成比例的污染暴露。在已提出的各种成因中，最受关注的是收入不平等、歧视以及企业成本（包括投入品成本和合规成本）。我们认为，另一渠道——信息——很可能在造成污染暴露差异方面发挥重要作用。我们提出了低估污染负担的多种原因，并给出了实证证据，表明这种低估可能对低收入家庭产生不成比例的影响。借助一个住房选择模型，我们推导出即使所有家庭面临的信息缺失相同，“隐性”污染仍会导致不平等的条件。这种不平等源于家庭会根据已知污染及其他不利环境因素进行分类，而我们表明这些因素与隐性污染呈正相关。为了帮助弥合环境正义与经济学之间的鸿沟，我们讨论了隐性信息与三种不同分配衡量指标之间的关系：污染暴露、隐性污染暴露，以及隐性污染导致的福利损失。

title: Machine Learning about Treatment Effect Heterogeneity: The Case of Household Energy Use
venue: American Economic Association Papers and Proceedings
abstract: We use causal forests to evaluate the heterogeneous treatment effects (TEs) of repeated behavioral nudges toward household energy conservation. The average response to treatment is a monthly electricity reduction of 9 kilowatt-hours (kWh), but the full distribution of responses ranges from -40 to +10 kWh. Households learn to reduce more over time, conditional on having responded in year one. Pre-treatment consumption and home value are the most commonly used predictors in the forest. The results suggest the ability to use machine learning techniques for improved targeting and tailoring of treatment.
abstract_zh: 我们使用因果森林（causal forests）评估了针对家庭节能的重复行为助推（nudge）的异质性处理效应（TE）。平均处理反应是每月减少9千瓦时（kWh）的用电量，但反应的完整分布范围从-40千瓦时到+10千瓦时。在第一年已作出反应的条件下，家庭随时间推移会学会减少更多用电。处理前用电量和住房价值是森林中最常用的预测变量。研究结果表明，机器学习技术有望用于改进处理的靶向性和个性化设计。

title: Forecasting the Impact of Connected and Automated Vehicles on Energy Use: A Microeconomic Study of Induced Travel and Energy Rebound
abstract: Connected and automated vehicles (CAVs) are expected to yield significant improvements in safety, energy efficiency, and time utilization. However, their net effect on energy and environmental outcomes is unclear. Higher fuel economy reduces the energy required per mile of travel, but it also reduces the fuel cost of travel, incentivizing more travel and causing an energy “rebound effect.” Moreover, CAVs are predicted to vastly reduce the time cost of travel, inducing further increases in travel and energy use. In this paper, we forecast the induced travel and rebound from CAVs using data on existing travel behavior. We develop a microeconomic model of vehicle miles traveled (VMT) choice under income and time constraints; then we use it to estimate elasticities of VMT demand with respect to fuel and time costs, with fuel cost data from the 2017 United States National Household Travel Survey (NHTS) and wage-derived predictions of travel time cost. Our central estimate of the combined price elasticity of VMT demand is -0.4, which differs substantially from previous estimates. We also find evidence that wealthier households have more elastic demand, and that households at all income levels are more sensitive to time costs than to fuel costs. We use our estimated elasticities to simulate VMT and energy use impacts of full, private CAV adoption under a range of possible changes to the fuel and time costs of travel. We forecast a 2-47% increase in travel demand for an average household. Our results indicate that backfire – i.e., a net rise in energy use – is a possibility, especially in higher income groups. This presents a stiff challenge to policy goals for reductions in not only energy use but also traffic congestion and local and global air pollution, as CAV use increases.
abstract_zh: 网联自动驾驶汽车（CAV）有望在安全性、能源效率和时间利用方面带来显著改善。然而，它们对能源和环境结果的净效应尚不明确。更高的燃油经济性降低了每英里出行所需的能源，但也降低了出行的燃料成本，从而激励更多出行，并引发能源“反弹效应”（rebound effect）。此外，据预测，网联自动驾驶汽车将大幅降低出行的时间成本，从而进一步诱发出行和能源使用的增长。在本文中，我们利用现有出行行为数据，预测网联自动驾驶汽车所诱发的出行增长及反弹效应。我们构建了一个在收入和时间约束下的车辆行驶里程（VMT）选择微观经济模型，并利用该模型估计VMT需求对燃料成本和时间成本的弹性，其中燃料成本数据来自2017年美国全国家庭出行调查（NHTS），时间成本则由工资推导的预测值得出。我们对VMT需求综合价格弹性的核心估计值为-0.4，这与以往的估计存在显著差异。我们还发现，较富裕的家庭需求弹性更大，并且各收入水平的家庭对时间成本的敏感性均高于对燃料成本的敏感性。我们利用估计的弹性，模拟了在一系列可能的燃料和出行时间成本变化下，全面私人采用网联自动驾驶汽车对VMT和能源使用的影响。我们预测，一个普通家庭的出行需求将增加2%至47%。我们的结果表明，“回弹失效”（backfire），即能源使用净增加，是一种可能性，在高收入群体中尤为如此。随着网联自动驾驶汽车使用的增加，这对降低能源使用、交通拥堵以及地方和全球空气污染的政策目标构成了严峻挑战。

title: Can Environmental Policy Reduce Infant Mortality? Evidence from the Ganga Pollution Cases
abstract: In many developing countries, environmental quality remains low and policies to improve it have been inconsistently effective. This paper conducts a case study of environmental policy in India, focusing on unprecedented Supreme Court rulings that targeted industrial pollution in the Ganga River. In a difference-in-differences framework, the rulings are found to have precipitated reductions in river pollution and one-month infant mortality, both of which persist for more than a decade. The authors then estimate a pollution-mortality dose-response function across twenty-nine rivers in the Ganga Basin, instrumenting for pollution with its upstream counterpart. The estimation reveals a significant external health burden of river pollution, not just in the district of measurement, but also on downstream communities. It further provides suggestive evidence that reducing pollution was an important driver behind declines in infant mortality observed after the rulings.
abstract_zh: 在许多发展中国家，环境质量仍然较低，而改善环境的政策效果一直不稳定。本文以印度的环境政策为案例，重点考察印度最高法院针对恒河工业污染作出的史无前例的裁决。在双重差分框架下，研究发现这些裁决促使河流污染减少，并使一个月龄以内婴儿死亡率下降，且这两方面的效果均持续了十多年。随后，作者以恒河流域29条河流为样本，估计了污染与死亡率之间的剂量反应函数，并以上游污染作为下游污染的工具变量。估计结果显示，河流污染不仅对测量地所在地区，而且对下游社区都产生了显著的外部健康负担。研究还提供了一些间接证据，表明污染的减少是裁决后观察到的婴儿死亡率下降的重要驱动因素。
